verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a single-URL scrape ('turn a URL into easily parseable text') and multi-entity dataset building, but nothing shows crawling every page of one website and returning all their content in one request. The dental-practice example is entity discovery across sources, not a site crawl, so it is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can crawl an entire website and get content from all its pages with one request
